title: TV Static
blurb: Fuzzy grey snow. It filled the screen back when a channel had nothing left to give you, and a small fraction of that noise was genuinely cosmic microwave background radiation left over from the Big Bang, which is a fantastic thing to tell people at parties. These days analogue static mostly signals horror — dead channels, cursed tapes, things standing just outside the frame. Reach for it on glitch transitions, found-footage edits, or the precise moment a scene goes wrong.
